purpose: Make publication a single immutable record creation after taskbook preparation/validation, remove the shared-registry write hotspot, make fresh dispatch consume the same canonical task definitions, and route live execution through recovery-aware research_control_dispatch.py without adding research-step GitHub traffic.

publication_transaction.prepare: May rewrite the draft taskbook only after in-memory normalization and successful machine lint; preparation has no task-existence authority.
publication_transaction.publish: Requires an already prepared current-policy-PASS taskbook in the shared taskbook format and creates exactly one immutable publication record with exclusive file creation.
publication_transaction.failure_semantics: If publication record creation fails, no task was published. Existing immutable records are never overwritten or silently rolled back.
publication_transaction.republication: A corrected generation must name the exact prior publication_id it supersedes.

interaction_budget.publication_boundary: One bounded taskbook + publication-record persistence batch when the task is actually published.
interaction_budget.post_publication: Resume the parent task immediately; no CI polling, review polling, scheduler heartbeat, or moving-main chase is required merely because publication occurred.
interaction_budget.side_residue: Capture once at the semantic checkpoint; do not interrupt ongoing research for repeated registry synchronization.

orphan_definition: A post-cutover executable taskbook/handoff/claim target without an immutable current publication record.
